notes: {"answer":"Go to the ER now. Fever with purple spots that don't fade when pressed needs urgent in-person assessment, even if your toddler seems okay. Don't wait to see if it changes, and don't give anything for the fever first.","triage":"Call 911 now if you can't get to the ER quickly, or if your child is drowsy, hard to wake, floppy, breathing fast, has a stiff neck or seizure, or the spots are spreading. 811 is not for this - go or call 911 now.","sources":["Royal Children's Hospital Melbourne","Banner Health","Kingston and Richmond NHS Foundation Trust"]}
